Title: Can i play samecard for two different effect?

Messages.Author: Kuruc
Messages.Body:
Hello, i have one question. Can i play one same card twice for two different effect?
For example Scry for Hearthstone ( i play one fir intercept and next card i play for cancel oponent obfuscate card.
Next example is Repulsion ( I play basic presence efect if i announced action and next i play other same card for stealth)

Thx for yours answer.

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
No.
See rulebook:

> Action modifier cards: The acting minion can play these cards to modify his action. For example, some action modifiers increase the acting minion's stealth or bleed amount or give him more votes. A minion cannot play the same action modifier more than once during a single action.
>
> Reaction cards: A ready unlocked minion can play a reaction card in response to an action taken by another Methuselah's minion (an action taken by one of a Methuselah's minions cannot be reacted to by any of her own minions). A minion cannot play the same reaction card more than once during a single action. A reaction card does not lock the minion using it.
>
Prince of Paris, France

Ratings Coordinator, Rules Director

Messages.Author: Kuruc

Ok, thx. And combat card? Can i play twice Heavens Gate ( first for prevent throught basic necromance and second card for obeah)
Or second question, if my vampire get some damage, can i play for example two or three Soak cards for prevent all damege? Or i can play only one Soak and i must play another prevent?

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
> Kuruc wrote:
> Ok, thx. And combat card?
>
By default, you can play the same combat card more than once (nothing forbids it in the rulebook).

> Kuruc wrote:
> Can i play twice Heavens Gate ( first for prevent throught basic necromance and second card for obeah)
>
Yes, even twice at [obe].

> Kuruc wrote:
> Or second question, if my vampire get some damage, can i play for example two or three Soak cards for prevent all damege? Or i can play only one Soak and i must play another prevent?
>
You can't play more than one Soak each round, per cardtext of Soak. Otherwise, you could play 3 Skin of Rock at superior for instance to prevent 6 damage.
